cases.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t JOIN json_each('[') j) SELECT x,value,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value) AS rn FROM c ORDER BY x,value
WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t JOIN json_each('null') j) SELECT x,value,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value) AS rn FROM c ORDER BY x,rn
WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t JOIN json_each('[]') j) SELECT x,value,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value) AS rn FROM c ORDER BY x,value
WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t JOIN json_each(NULL) j) SELECT x,value,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value) AS rn FROM c ORDER BY x,value
WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t JOIN json_each('[null,1.5,1.5,"a","A"]') j) SELECT x,value,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value) AS rn FROM c ORDER BY x,rn
WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t LEFT JOIN json_each('[]') j ON 1) SELECT x,value,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value) AS rn FROM c ORDER BY x,rn
WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t JOIN json_each('[null,1.5,1.5,2]') j) SELECT x,value,sum(value) OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value) AS total FROM c ORDER BY x,value

WITH c AS (SELECT t.x,j.value FROM t JOIN json_each('["a","A","b"]') j) SELECT x,value,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY x ORDER BY value COLLATE NOCASE ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n FROM c ORDER BY x,value
